speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: It was only to keep our core body temperatures from plummeting.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: For me, it was a bonding moment.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Sheldon, you remember the first few weeks we were looking for magnetic monopoles and not finding anything and you were acting like an obnoxious, giant dictator?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I thought we were going to be gentle with him.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: That's why I added the tator. And then when we found our first positive data, you were so happy.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, yes. In the world of emoticons, I was colon, capital D.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Well, in actuality, what your equipment detected wasn't so much evidence of paradigm-shifting monopoles as it was... static from the electric can opener we were turning on and off.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: He just went colon, capital O.
